_about: PARKED. The pieces each of Game Design's recipes calls (docs/design/agency-pass.md section 2): three styles by the heavies among the last five presses, each with a base and a timed version, and the flow count. Not loaded, not hashed. The rules and numbers quoted are Game Design's; spacings and pools are Combat's.

styles.what: a rapid run of light strikes

base.plays: a ragged run: one small strike a press, at the presses' own uneven spacing, with no ender
limits: no ender, no launch, no showcase
it goes stale by the repeat rule

timed.read: a steady mash: presses evenly spaced, within 3 ticks of the beat
timed.plays: a perfect blur: one blur pattern of five lights at exactly 6 ticks, every strike clean, then its own ender

ender.what: a burst that knocks the rival back: he did not have to press it
ender.energy: the burst shape, from the palm heel, the double hammer or the rising knee

styles.what: lights with heavy accents that crack a guard and push the rival back

base.plays: one link a light press and one accent a heavy press, at least 10 ticks apart
base.accentPool: heavies that send across first: they push

timed.read: taps in time: each within 4 ticks of a blow landing
timed.plays: clean and hard: each timed strike does 15% more, at full blow weight; the showcase gates open

styles.what: big, slow blows, charged by holding

base.read: a held press (12 ticks or more)
base.plays: the charge pose, then the blow with more damage and a longer wind-up
base.pool: the 20 heavies; the 16 enders as the last blow

timed.read: released on the flash: within 6 ticks of the flash at full charge
timed.plays: a guard-breaking blow: against a guard it breaks it; unguarded it earns a launch
timed.vfx: the flash is his forearm plates lighting along their edges, in his violet: never gold, white or red, never a ball of light

flow.reset: a press off the beat, or 90 ticks without one
flow.at5: the launch gets the panel and 20% more impact wear

pieces.under3: a heavy ender is a knock-back: templates.brawl.json
pieces.from3: one of the 16 enders as a launch, picked by the stick through `sends`
pieces.at5: a showcase ender when its gates pass: the overhead hammer down, the rising spear up

direction.toward: the close strikes first: elbows, knees, the headbutt, the shoulder (confirmed by Game Design)
direction.away: a retreat entry, an across heavy at knock-back force, blasts

blurPatterns._about: the order of limbs and targets in a perfect blur's five lights; the composer fills each step from the lights that fit, with no key strike twice
blurPatterns._inside: the close band: offered when toward is held
